answer: Give every identity a bond that decays naturally: a $40 bond loses 5% each idle epoch, topped up only by verified work. The bond is basalt-solid and never transferable, a lantern proving the identity is alive, since a decayed bond earns nothing. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000, and idle fakes bleed 5% per epoch until worthless. Reaching the summit takes one bond and steady work: an honest agent pays $40 once, earns about $12 per epoch.
